observations.value: Intermediate consumption estimated from input quantities and prices, primarily using expert opinion and technical coefficients because direct data on input use and costs were limited.
observations.status: Important methodological limitation: CEA aggregates are context only and cannot replace farm-level crop budgets.

sources.notes: CEA reports production value, intermediate consumption and gross value added at national product/sector level. The report explicitly warns that some input consumption estimates rely on expert opinion and technical coefficients due limited direct data; do not treat these national aggregates as enterprise budgets.

blockers: Extract EAC 2023-2024 report tables, microdata and codebook; inspect crop-cut yields, GPS plot areas, weights, strata, standard errors and regional sample sizes; preserve Kidal exclusion and verify Bamako coverage.
Extract crop-specific regional sown/harvested area, production and yield distributions; do not infer individual crop yields from national cereal aggregates.
Reconcile Government 2025 cereal total 11,452,540 tonnes with FAO estimate about 11.6m tonnes.
Extract DGMP 2026 regional Mercuriale PDFs and classify each price as procurement/reference, wholesale, retail or farmgate.
Obtain current dated farmgate transactions by crop, grade, market and region; historical rice quotes and wholesale panels are not substitutes.

Verify 2026 input subsidy eligibility, formulation, allocation, delivery point and farmer-paid costs; obtain commercial seed, crop protection, labour, machinery, irrigation, energy and transport prices.
Build regional crop and livestock enterprise budgets, including irrigated Office du Niger rice versus rainfed systems, and validate XOF tests.
Extract the official EAC 2023-24 synthetic report (PDF) and yield-square questionnaire; transcribe crop-specific planted/harvested area, production and yield by region and assess sampling/precision.
Use CEA 2021-2025 only as national economic context; its production values and intermediate-consumption aggregates are not per-hectare budgets, and some input costs rely on expert coefficients.
Validate the CEA's historical producer-price references (paddy rice 2022, groundnut 2023, sesame 2025) against current 2026 regional farmgate transactions before use.
extraction_status: 2026-11-04 follow-up: official CPS/SDR 2023-24 EAC report catalogue and table-of-contents verified; 3.56MB synthetic report and dedicated yield-square questionnaire identified, numerical crop tables not yet extracted. New INSTAT CEA 2021-2025 report extracted for national production values, selected historical producer-price references and aggregate intermediate-consumption context. CEA unit costs are not sufficiently disaggregated for calculator use and its input-consumption methodology partly relies on expert coefficients. Mali remains inactive.
